problem_restatement.observed: V58 has two short-only BTC Hulk routes and one selective hourly downside-sweep long route. The current upside move produced no eligible long because it did not first sweep below the prior twenty-hour low with the required volume.
problem_restatement.tested: A preregistered long-only completed-15-minute mechanism in which Binance BTCUSDT spot breaks its prior thirty-two-bar high during a Hyperliquid BTC hourly uptrend while the comparable Hyperliquid perpetual bar still lags its own high.
controls: an otherwise comparable Hyperliquid-native completed-15-minute breakout
the Binance spot condition shifted backward by exactly sixty minutes

nominal_control_comparison.interpretation: The spot-lead condition filtered out many damaging native and lag-placebo breakouts, but it did not create positive, concentrated-winner-robust expectancy and remained worse than no action in development and pseudo-holdout.

accepted: The exact candidate is economically falsified under the preregistered development, validation, pseudo-holdout, stress, delay, largest-winner, cadence, and no-action requirements.
The validation profit is too small and too concentrated: it turns negative after removing the largest winner and contains only five trades.
The pseudo-holdout remains negative under nominal, stress, and delayed-entry scenarios.
The absence of a V58 BTC long remains a strategy-coverage limitation rather than evidence of a router, sizing, order, or TUI failure.
not_established: that all cross-venue spot information lacks predictive value
that subminute aggressive-flow or order-book lead-lag would behave like completed fifteen-minute bars
that no future BTC-long strategy can be robustly profitable
failure_modes: Completed fifteen-minute bars may be too slow to capture cross-venue price discovery that occurs within seconds.
A bar-level entry model cannot reproduce private receipt latency, queue position, or transient depth.
The already-opened chronological partitions limit the evidentiary value of nearby retuning and make post-hoc threshold rescue invalid.
A future source reconstruction defect could change signal identities or economics.

decision.next_action: Do not add or retune another completed-bar BTC breakout variant. Preserve the selective sweep control. Rank the already-predeclared route-specific SP500 and BRENTOIL profit-lock forward watchers above another BTC-long experiment while they accumulate independent completed lifecycles. Any later BTC-long experiment should use genuinely new point-in-time subminute flow or order-book information and receive a separate feasibility review and preregistration.

falsifiers: A source, checksum, normalization, causality, partition, signal, fill, fee, funding, or accounting defect changes the reproduced trade identities or economics.
An eligible V58 BTC-long evaluation is shown to have been withheld, rejected, or lost downstream; the current live prefix reports zero eligible evaluations and zero submissions.

A prospectively frozen materially distinct mechanism using additional point-in-time information passes validation, pseudo-holdout, cost, delay, concentration, shared-capital, and execution-feasibility tests.

Independent prospective evidence under the unchanged exact spot-lead rule becomes positive after costs and remains positive without the largest winner across enough events to satisfy a separately frozen sample threshold.
